description:
Please note this property is subject to a planning condition in relation to short term letting as such it may only be suitable for a cash buyer or purchaser who has an investment mortgage. We would recommend that all potential purchasers ensure that they can proceed with a proposed purchase in advance of bidding.

Quinn Property Management presents to the market this bright and spacious 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home located in the highly regarded Castle Gardens development in Bunratty, Co. Clare.

Ideally situated in one of Clare's most sought-after residential locations, this attractive property offers comfortable and practical living accommodation within walking distance of Bunratty Village and its world-renowned castle and folk park. The property also benefits from excellent connectivity, with Shannon, Limerick City and the M18 motorway all easily accessible.

Upon entering, you are welcomed by a bright entrance hallway leading to a well-proportioned open-plan living and dining area. This inviting space features timber flooring, a stylish fireplace and large double doors opening to the rear garden, allowing natural light to flood the room while creating an ideal setting for both relaxing and entertaining.

The kitchen is conveniently located off the living area and is fitted with a range of modern wall and floor units, ample worktop space, tiled splashbacks and integrated appliances, providing everything required for modern-day living. The first of three bedrooms is located on the ground floor, carpeted flooring making a warm and cosy first room. Finally, a full bathroom completes the ground floor accommodation with full shower, toilet and sink .

Upstairs, the property comprises three well-appointed bedrooms, including two generous double bedrooms. Both bedrooms benefits from a private ensuite bathroom, while the remaining bedroom is serviced by a spacious family bathroom downstairs. With three bathrooms in total, the home is perfectly suited to families, first-time buyers, investors, or those seeking a low-maintenance property in a superb location.

Externally, the property enjoys a pleasant setting within the development, with communal green areas nearby and off-street parking. The rear garden provides an ideal outdoor space for dining, relaxing, or enjoying time with family and friends.

Presented in good decorative order throughout and situated in a mature and well-maintained development, this property offers an excellent opportunity to acquire a home in the heart of Bunratty.

Viewing is highly recommended and strictly by appointment with Quinn Property Management.
